title: PAR-138 DetailViewStyle group-3 label attachment/alignment insertion fast slice
mode: Generated ASCII/Binary implementation and focused regression validation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Insert missing DetailViewStyle group-3 view-label attachment/alignment values (DXF group 90) during same-version raw-carrier export.
Preserve occurrence mapping when an edited later slot follows omitted earlier slots.
Verify generated ASCII/Binary output with exact ordered raw groups, typed readback, and style-resource closure.

implementation.behavior: The DetailViewStyle overlay inserts missing group-3 group-90 occurrences through the highest edited attachment/alignment slot. When alignment is edited while both original occurrences are absent, it emits the current/default attachment slot first, followed by the edited alignment. Values use signed DXF long representation to preserve the 32-bit wire pattern.
testCases: Remove both group-3 group-90 values from a generated primary DetailViewStyle, confirm typed defaults, edit alignment to 7, export/reimport in ASCII and Binary DXF, and assert attachment 0 precedes alignment 7.
Compare complete ordered raw DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle carriers and verify typed readback and closed style-resource references.

limitations: Same-source-version DXF typed-field insertion/replay only; no DWG-origin typed serialization or cross-version projection qualification.
The generated control verifies one later-slot insertion and its default predecessor, not all malformed or ambiguous occurrence profiles.
No native view-label rendering or broad DetailViewStyle semantic-completeness claim follows.
The shared worktree is uncommitted and contains unrelated user changes; no cleanup or staging was performed.
